findings.summary: RegimePlanAction type definition could use a discriminated union for tighter compile-time safety on exitIntent.
findings.suggested_fix: export type RegimePlanAction = { type: 'HOLD' | 'STAND_DOWN'; reasonCode: string; exitIntent?: never } | { type: 'REQUEST_EXIT_CLMM'; reasonCode: string; exitIntent: RegimePlanExitIntent };
